The StatefulSet "app" could not start because its volume claim template referenced a StorageClass named `fast-ssd` that did not exist in the cluster. The PVC `data-app-0` was in Pending state with error: `"storageclass.storage.k8s.io 'fast-ssd' not found"`.

provisioner: rancher.io/local-path

volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
